title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.191 - Added `old_source` field to `NotebookEdit` tool results for `replace` and `delete` operations, enabling inline diffs - Added `seven_day_overage_included` to `SDKRateLimitInfo.rateLimitType` for per-model weekly usage limits - Added `model_scoped` array to usage response for per-model weekly limit windows with utilization and reset times - Fixed fast mode reverting to standard after the first turn when `settingSources` includes user/project settings ## 0.3.190 - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.190 ## 0.3.188 - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.188
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
